# ZAWYA

> > ZAWYA is the trusted source for comprehensive business, finance, and market news across the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and global markets.

ZAWYA provides in-depth coverage of capital markets, economic policy, and sectoral business news with specialized focus on Islamic finance, GCC economies, and emerging markets. The platform serves investors, analysts, and business professionals with real-time market insights and regional economic analysis.

## Key Topics

- Capital Markets
- Equities & Bonds
- Islamic Finance
- GCC Economy
- Emerging Markets
- Oil & Commodities
- Banking & Insurance
- Foreign Exchange
- Central Banks
- Middle East
- Africa
- Sukuk
- Market Analysis
- Economic Policy
- Global Trade

## Capital Markets

- [Capital Markets Hub](https://www.zawya.com/en/capital-markets): Capital markets hub covering equities, bonds, dividends, acquisitions globally
- [Equities](https://www.zawya.com/en/capital-markets/equities): Global equities news and stock listings from Hong Kong, China, Europe
- [Bonds](https://www.zawya.com/en/capital-markets/bonds): Global bonds news: government bonds, issuance, treasuries, emerging markets
- [Loans & Credit](https://www.zawya.com/en/capital-markets/loans): Loans and credit facilities news from Middle East and global markets

## Economy & Markets

- [Economy Hub](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy): Economic and policy news from GCC, UAE, Egypt, and global regions
- [Global Economic News](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/global): Global economic and policy news covering trade, tech, employment, forex
- [GCC Economy](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/gcc): GCC regional news: economy, trade, oil prices, business from Gulf states
- [Policy & Regulation](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/policy): Global policy news: GCC, inflation, oil markets, government regulations

## Regional Coverage

- [Africa News](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/africa): Sub-Saharan Africa economic news: energy, infrastructure, currency, agriculture
- [North Africa News](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/north-africa): North Africa news: Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia economy, energy, investment
- [Levant News](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/levant): Levant region news: Jordan economy, agriculture, tourism, food security

## Islamic Finance

- [Islamic Economy](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/islamic-economy): Islamic finance news: sukuk, Islamic banking, Sharia-compliant investments
- [Islamic Economy Reports](https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/islamic-reports): Islamic economy reports: sukuk, Islamic banking, market development analysis
- [Islamic Finance Glossary](https://www.zawya.com/en/islamic-economy/glossary): Islamic finance glossary: Islamic law, Fiqh definitions, Sharia terminology

## Business Sectors

- [Business Hub](https://www.zawya.com/en/business): Business news from Middle East, Africa, Asia: logistics, oil-gas, telecom
- [Banking & Insurance](https://www.zawya.com/en/business/banking-and-insurance): Banking and insurance sector news from Middle East, Africa, Asia
- [Commodities](https://www.zawya.com/en/business/commodities): Commodities news: oil, metals, gold, grains, energy prices globally
- [Currencies & Forex](https://www.zawya.com/en/business/currencies): Currency and forex news: emerging markets, dollar, central banks
- [Aviation](https://www.zawya.com/en/business/aviation): Aviation news: airlines, aircraft, Middle East carriers, flight operations
